findings.text: follow-on: _process_is_running is defined but never called, and _records_the_live_producer at line 188 compares only the recorded start time, so the zombie exclusion the function's own comment describes is not applied and a zombie producer still carrying its start time reads as fresh; _NOT_FRESH_REASONS at line 54 is likewise defined and never referenced.

justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:432 sweep() writes each registered session's snapshot atomically (write_snapshot:365) on the three triggers §2 names, and reckon/crew/runs.py:1571 _publish_obligation_snapshots drives it from the watch producer, matching the plan's §2 and §3.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in reckon/crew/runs.py, reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py, tests/test_obligations_snapshot_is_published.py and the fragment is a declared write path; the only out-of-change lines are two incidental ruff reformats (renew_producer_lease and the watch_producer_identity detail string) carried in the same file the change edits.
